{{Quote|First, I hereby invoke the Hutt Commercial Laws, section c, subsection 12.4e, and the protections it affords all counselors and messengers|Ghitsa Dogder|<ref name="Hutt and Seek">{{StoryCite|story=Hutt and Seek|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> }}
The '''Hutt Commercial Laws''' were a set of rules and regulations created by the [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidics]] that protected their [[Hutt counselor|counselors]]. It was to ensure that those individuals that used these laws were not punished for acts made to embarrass or cheat the [[Hutt Empire]]. Section c, subsection 12.4e specifically handled the protection of a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] counselors and messengers.

==History==
{{Quote|Counselors and messengers are not to pay the price for those who use them to embarrass or cheat the Hutt Empire|Durga Besadii Tai|<ref name="Hutt and Seek">{{StoryCite|story=Hutt and Seek|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> }}
Hutt Commercial Laws stated that if any agent of a specific Hutt was killed, all the deals made by that clan family were made forfeit which in turn could lead to millions worth of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] being lost. It was first enacted after a number of early and violent deaths of twelve counselors along with numberless messengers. The last known moment that this law was broken was in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] when a young Hutt of the [[Vermilic]] Clan forgot the prohibition leading to him disintegrating his counselors. The incident left the clan bankrupt with no Hutt activity within the region for three months.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Ghitsa Dogder]] enacted the law to prevent [[Durga Besadii Tai]] from killing her after the loss of several [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].
